reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) supports that ZrC forms a second phase and improves corrosion resistance in NaCl solution, but provides no data on oxidation resistance, high-temperature thermal cycling, or the proposed barrier mechanism. The hypothesis overstates the evidence by extrapolating from room-temperature corrosion to high-temperature oxidation and TBC durability.
